name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 7 visits over 10 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 19 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 10 hours starting 2025-07-19, at wavelengths from 1.34 to 2.21 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
